soundness_flags.label: ass:selected-cell-positivity / def:model-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The model class quantifies generic SCMs without declaring discrete state spaces or a dominating measure, so “every joint cell v” and P_M(V=v,S=1)>0 are undefined for the allowed non-discrete variables; restrict V to finite/discrete state spaces or state an appropriate density/support formulation.

The paper defines a forward SCM conditioning operation for latent selection, establishes its interaction with interventions and notes that ancestors of selection are generally non-intervenable in the conditioned representation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Make the state-space regime explicit: declare finite discrete observed variables for the exact selected-cell formulation, or replace cell masses by a stated dominated-density positivity condition throughout.

Before pursuing the universal lift, publish the complete symbolic response-type calculation for G_star, including a displayed positive same-selected-law pair or a certified fiber-constancy obstruction.

Specify a finite representation for the inverse-lift search and give a complexity or certificate-size bound; this would make the success-or-certificate claim independently algorithmic rather than a packaging corollary.

recommended_next_step: Revise the state-space and positivity specification, then advance the explicitly anchored flagship completeness kernel to Stage 0 with the G_star fiber calculation as its first kill gate.
